title: Prompt code path is selected only by an effective is_prompt tag value of true
answers: prompt tag set to false still skips run validation when registering a model version
duplicate is_prompt tags on create model version
why does a model version with mlflow.prompt.is_prompt false go through prompt validation
non-prompt model version bypasses source run checks
body:
Invariant: CreateModelVersion takes the prompt branch only when the effective mlflow.prompt.is_prompt tag value is "true" (compared case-insensitively). Duplicate tag keys collapse with the last value winning, the same way ModelVersion._is_prompt resolves them.
Enforced by: mlflow/server/handlers.py:_is_prompt_request, which builds a dict from request_message.tags before checking the value.
What breaks if skipped: any tag value, including "false", used to select the prompt branch, which skipped _validate_source_run and _validate_source_model for a regular model version. A [true, false] pair also selected the prompt path while the stored entity was not a prompt.
Constraints: the prompt branch and the regular branch must agree with the entity-level prompt check; change both together or tests for duplicate and non-true values will diverge.
applies: Any code in the model registry create path that decides prompt versus regular model version from request tags.
says: Setting the prompt indicator tag to false erroneously bypasses source run validation checks.
Registering a standard model version incorrectly follows the prompt creation flow.
Enforce source model verification whenever the prompt label is marked false.
Ensure model version registration only treats items as prompts when explicitly flagged true.
search: During model version creation, the prompt handling branch must only be taken when the effective mlflow.prompt.is_prompt tag value case-insensitively equals 'true'. In mlflow/server/handlers.py:_is_prompt_request and _create_model_version, request tags are converted to a dictionary where duplicate keys resolve with the last value winning. This prevents non-true values such as 'false' from skipping _validate_source_run and _validate_source_model, ensuring the create handler stays synchronized with entity-level prompt checks.
